text_block_list.text:
"While checking the newspaper for info
on the Umamusume running in today's race—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nnya?
Trai-pi, is that today's article~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait, isn't that basically writing about all the girls who are running?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm in here too!
Lemme see, lemme see~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Maybe there's something exciting written hereâ

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!? Favorite to win!?!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you're praising me so much!!
I'm so haaaappppyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, aren't I amazing!?
Wait, does everyone really think I'm gonna win!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aaaand that makes it my turn! Time for DJ Me's solo stage, here we gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we've gotta prep for the festival, no doubt about it!
'Cause yours truly is gonna win it all☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For now, pom-poms, a mic, and maybe launch some silver streamers? Ooh, soap bubbles could work too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I totally spilled juice all over!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My shoes are totally soaked!
Well, whatever, I'll just wipe 'em off! Ahahahahaha!

"...Knowing she's the fan favorite seems to have Daitaku Helios
on cloud nine.
I have a bad feeling about this..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! I'm not the favorite?!
choice_data_list: Ah... don't worry too much about it—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Which means, wouldn't it be crazy if I actually won here?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, starting from the low to an all-time high? Giant killing vibes?
Annnnd then... festival vibes??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's totally insane, the hype is gonna be off the charts!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm totally getting fired up!
Watch me, Trai-pippi!

Finding out she isn't the race favorite
seems to have fired her up even more.
Can we expect big things from her...?
